notes.title: Demo build live, Replacing Playtest
notes.content:
Hi Folks!
Thanks to everyone who helped my playtest Synchronicity thus far! 
For logistical reasons (Steam Next Fest) and maintainability (one less build to patch) I'm closing down the Playtest. 
I've launched the Demo instead and it is functionally identical. You can simply continue with the Demo build and even matches started in the Playtest should function the same way.

If you have Offline games or Custom Maps from the Playtest, you'll need to copy those over manually.

Cheers!

notes.title: Patch #10 - Replay QoL
notes.content:
[b][h3]Features[/h3][/b]
[list]
[*][b]Replay pause and step by step playback[/b]
	Replays can now be paused and advanced step by step to better analyse what happened. You can also replay the full game up to this point without reloading the match.
[/list]
[list]
[*][b]Prompt for selecting notifications[/b]
	The Discord notifications have been tested over the last month and the seem to work as expected. New Players, or Players that have not selected any notifications yet will be prompted to select a notification method when playing online matches.
[/list]
[b][h3]Changes[/h3][/b]
[list]
[*][b]Peeking around corners now also works out of windows and low walls in general[/b]
	It was previously not possible to peek around a corner when a low wall (a window for example) was in the way. This should make some situations less confusing.
[/list]
[b][h3]Improvements[/h3][/b]
[list]
[*][b]Fixed Flash being able to block toxic smoke[/b]
	Flash was able to block the spread of the toxic smoke grenade with her Block ability.
[/list]
[list]
[*][b]Fixed Overwatch zone showing walls you didn't know about yet.[/b]
	When using the Overwatch ability, the UI preview would show you walls as destroyed that you hadn't seen yet. Now the UI is based on what you actually can know.
[/list]
[list]
[*][b]Fixed Walls disappearing correctly in replays[/b]
	When viewing the opponents perspective at the end of a Match, the walls would not be properly destroyed visually.
[/list]
[list]
[*][b]Peeking angles now more align with actual sightlines[/b]
	It happened quite often that a shot that was unobstructed visually hit walls and passed through them without loosing power. The bullet paths now should be more accurate.
 [/list]

notes.title: Patch #9 - Notification via Discord
notes.content:
Hi folks! 
I improved notifications via discord! You can enable discord notifications under Options->Privacy. Its a bit hidden at the moment, It'll become more prominent in the future.
You also have to join my [url=https://discord.gg/ZG6pdJcSGr]Discord Server[/url] so the bot has permission to write you messages.

If you enable discord notifications you'll get a private message from the Synchronicity Bot telling you which game requires a new turn from you.

[b]Other Improvements[/b]
[list]
[*]Changed color of pistol and healing pistol
[*]Fixed Shotgun damage issues
[*]Fixed Constructs walls not blocking explosions
[/list]

notes.title: Patch #8 - MacOS and Tox buffs
notes.content:
[h2]MacOS Build Available[/h2]
Thanks to the help form a community member I managed to build a mac version! The performance is (probably) not optimal, but hopefully its workable for the playtest.

[h2]Balancing Changes[/h2]
[list]
[*][b]Grappling Hook limited to 3 uses total[/b]
	You can no longer spam the grappling hook all around but will need to use it strategically 
[*][b]New Shotgun bullet pattern[/b]
	The new patterns have higher damage and range in general as well as 4 additional directions for more versatility
[*][b]Armor no longer blocks toxic smoke[/b]
	Toxic smoke is not unaffected by the Heavy's Armor ability, making it a good option against her
[*][b]Block no longer blocks grenades[/b]
	Probably no one even know you could block grenades with Flash' Block ability, and now you can't anymore :)
[/list]

notes.title: Patch #7 - Tutorial and Puzzles
notes.content:
Hi folks!

I just added Tutorial and Puzzle mode to the game. This should make it a little easier to get into the game before playing online. Multiplayer is and always will be the focus, but having a good introduction for new players is super important.

If its your first time launching the game the tutorial should start right away. Otherwise you'll find a "Puzzles" button in the main menu. Please share any feedback you have either here in the forums or on Discord <3



[b]Features[/b]
[list]
[*]Added an introductory tutorial level
[*]Added puzzles to teach mechanics
[/list]

[b]Fixes[/b]
[list]
[*]Fixed Overwatch not triggering some time
[/list]
[b]Visuals[/b]
[list]
[*]Smoke effects now disappears correctly
[*]EMP effects now disappear at the correct time
[*]EMP preview show when the zone disappears 
[/list]

notes.title: Patch #6 - Grappling Hook & Slowzones
notes.content:
[b]Fixes[/b]
[list]
[*]Grappling Hook now takes Slowzone into account.
[*]Fixed EMP zone preview being blocked by walls.
[*]Slowzone now properly blocked by walls.
[*]Fixed Smokes effects not being removed correctly in some situations 
[/list]

[b]Improvements[/b]
[list]
[*]Tweaked Slowzone timing to better show the zone is active.
[*]Added "(slowed)" to the Action in the timeline whenever its slowed by a Slowzone.
[/list]

notes.title: Incremental Patch #5
notes.content:
Based on feedback I added some more abilities to make Brains and Gadget more versatile! All newly started matches will use the new abilities. Give it a go and tell me what you think!


[b]Additions[/b]
[list]
[*]Added Grappling Hook ability for Gadget. Once per round she can hook-shot herself around the map (within range)
[*]Brains now has a heal projectile that can heal others at a distance. Simply shoot at your allies to heal them by one.
[/list]
[b]Changes[/b]
[list]
[*]EMP grenades now ignore walls
[/list]

notes.title: Incremental Patch #4
notes.content:
[b]Fixes[/b] 
[list]
[*]Breaking a wall with Heavy now also works when standing in a slow-zone.
[*]Fixed preview of overwatch when looking through a popup-shield. It previously showed the zone as attackable, even behind the shield.
[/list]

[b]Improvements[/b]
[list]
[*]Added damage preview zone when breaking a wall with a shotgun (deals damage in the tile behind the wall)
[*]Renamed "Trapper" to "Tox" to more accurately describe her role.
[*]Improved death timings ( health-bars stay a little longer, animation plays a little earlier) to make things a little clearer.
[*]Improved animation playback quality
[/list]

notes.title: Incremental Patch #3
notes.content:
[h3]Improvements[/h3]
[list]
[*] The slow-zone now has a preview zone when it activates
[*] Added "Vision Tester" tool. Use it so see what a unit could see if it was standing at a certain position.
[*] Added tutorial videos for Overwatch and the Overwatch/Scan interaction
[/list]
[h3]Fixes[/h3]
[list]
[*] Fixed shotgun doing more damage than it should
[/list]
[h3]Visuals[/h3]

[/list]

notes.title: Incremental patch #2
notes.content:
**Fixes** 
* Ambience sounds now scale with Effects Volume
* Flash now ends up at the correct position when being blocked half-way through a dash action
* Fixed explosion visuals when using wall breach

notes.title: Incremental patch #1
notes.content:
While I pushed a lot of patches in the last few months I want to start updating you here about whats happening :)
So here are the Patch notes for patch #1

[b]Balancing Changes[/b]
[list]
[*] Overwatching a wall breach now triggers a shot in the same timestep
[*]  Wall breach does 2 damage on the other side (instead of 1)
[*]  Shotgun now deals 1 damage on the tile behind the wall when breaking a wall
[*]  When both players die in the same round the game will no longer draw, but instead result in a win for the defenders
[/list]

[b]Visual Tweaks[/b]
[list]
[*] Bullets for Aim and Overwatch now have different visual timings to highlight their differences
[/list]

notes.title: Synchronicity Public Playtest starts NOW!
notes.content:
Hi!
This is Simon, the developer of Synchronicity.
I've been developing the game for quite a few years now and I'm finally ready to welcome in a bunch of fresh eyes to have a look and play. 

So if you are interested: hop on in, play some games and enjoy yourselves.
If you find any issues or have some ideas/feedback I'd love to hear from you. 
I've already tested the current build with a few people to iron out the most obvious kinks, but some issues will only appear in the wild. (there are some known issues, but nothing major)

[h2]How to give feedback / report issues[/h2]
[list]
[*] Find the "Report an issue" button in the top right corner
[*] Join the [url=https://discord.gg/YCDpEBUz4T]Discord channel[/url]
[*] Use the Steam Discussion forums on here 
[/list]

[h2]What kind of feedback am I looking for?[/h2]
[list]
[*] [b]Readability[/b]: You don't get what a thing is doing, or something is not visible to you that should be
[*] [b]Balance[/b]: Something is overpowered, exploitable or just annoying. Of course from one single perspective this will be biased, but with enough games played I'll hope to get some hard data on this.
[*] [b]Missing but expected features[/b]: From what you know about the game before playing, is there anything you expected to find, but didn't?
[*] [b]Bugs and other issues[/b] you may find :)
[/list]


Cheers and have fun!
Simon
